channel.title: The Center For Michigan | Bridge Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Center For Michigan | Bridge Magazine (thecenterformichigan.net)

item.title: Ex-governors urge civility: Minneapolis ‘could be any place in Michigan’
item.description: With tensions high and political divides growing, former Michigan governors say it doesn’t have to be this way.

item.title: Dana Nessel asks residents to report ‘concerning’ ICE actions in Michigan
item.description: Attorney General Dana Nessel unveils 'immigration action reporting form’ to collect eyewitness accounts of ICE in Michigan. Critics worry the effort could make it harder for law enforcement to do their jobs.

item.title: Whitmer on Trump election take over talk: ‘Won’t happen on my watch’
item.description: Pointing to Detroit, President Donald Trump suggested the federal government 'get involved' in elections run by states. Gov. Gretchen Whitmer says that won't happen in Michigan in her watch.

item.title: How much lottery ticket cash ends up in Michigan classrooms? We did the math
item.description: Every day, people hoping to win big contribute to the state’s School Aid Fund. But is that money enough to pay for schools?

item.title: Michigan House passes bill to lift deer baiting ban in the Lower Peninsula
item.description: The state House bill would allow deer baiting throughout the Lower Peninsula regardless of whether chronic wasting disease had been detected or not.

item.title: Want to see what a ski jumper sees? Michigan project would make it easier
item.description: A new elevator at the Pine Mountain Ski Jump would make it easier for tourists to reach the top of the jump and take in the views. But organizers need about $1 million to finish it up.

item.title: Ice caves forming on the Great Lakes, bringing beauty and danger
item.description: Natural phenomena on the Great Lakes are beautiful, but adventurers head out on the ice at their own risk.

item.title: Elissa Slotkin rejects DOJ interview ask in ‘illegal orders’ video probe
item.description: Michigan US Sen. Elissa Slotkin says she won't sit for an interview with the Justice Department regarding a probe into a video she organized urging U.S. military members to resist 'illegal orders.'

item.title: Henry Ford sells a SE Michigan hospital to mental health provider
item.description: A Warren-based behavioral health provider will open a 100-bed behavioral health hospital at Henry Ford Health’s Madison Heights hospital once Henry Ford vacates it.

item.title: Grow Michigan’s economy? Many pledges, few plans at gubernatorial forum
item.description: Top candidates for governor offered a handful of ideas to jumpstart Michigan’s economy. Among them: Expand a ‘transformation brownfield’ tax capture program for developers, and ‘take a blowtorch to bureaucracy.’
